title: Skillet Burgers on Pretzel Buns
description: 1 lb 80/20 ground beef, thawed. Makes 3 (1/3 lb) or 4 (1/4 lb) burgers.

ingredients.item: toppings: Duke's, mustard (yellow, spicy brown, or honey), a little ketchup, BBQ sauce, candied jalapenos

steps: Divide the beef. Shape patties about 3/4 inch thick, slightly wider than the bun. Press a shallow dent in the center with your thumb (stops puffing). Don't overwork the meat.
Season both sides right before cooking.
Start the hash browns (R2) in the oven first; they take longer.
Heat a skillet over medium-high with a little oil. Cook patties 4 min without moving. Flip.
Cook 3 to 4 min more. Add cheese in the last minute, cover the pan to melt.
Done at 160°F in the center (no pink in the middle).
Wipe out most of the grease, butter the cut sides of the buns, toast in the skillet 30 to 60 seconds.
Build and serve with hash browns.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R22
notes: 20 min. Leftover cooked patties: fridge 3 to 4 days, or freeze. Reheat in microwave at 50% power 1 to 2 min, or in a skillet.

healthy: Ground beef gives plenty of protein.
not_healthy: 80/20 beef, cheese and butter add saturated fat.
Pretzel buns are refined flour and often salty.
Mayo, BBQ sauce, ketchup and candied jalapenos add fat and sugar.
